callbacks.name: onCreate
callbacks.description: Fired when the script starts loading.
callbacks.beginner: Use this to create sprites, set variables, and prepare the scene.
callbacks.example:
function onCreate()
    makeLuaSprite('logo', 'logo', 0, 0)
    addLuaSprite('logo', true)
end
tips: This normally runs once.
Create assets here before trying to animate them.

callbacks.name: onCreatePost
callbacks.description: Fired after characters, stage, and UI are created.
callbacks.beginner: Use this when your code needs the game objects to exist first.
tips: Prefer onCreate for your own sprites.
Use this for changing objects created by the engine.

callbacks.name: onUpdate
callbacks.beginner: Use this for continuous movement or checks. elapsed is the time since the previous frame.
tips: Keep per-frame work small.
Do not start a new timer every frame unless that is intentional.

callbacks.name: onUpdatePost
callbacks.description: Fired every frame after character updates.
callbacks.beginner: Use this when your adjustment should happen after the engine updates characters.
tips: Use onUpdate when ordering does not matter.

callbacks.name: onBeatHit
callbacks.beginner: Use this to pulse, move, or change something in time with the music.
tips: A beat is less frequent than a step.

callbacks.name: onStepHit
callbacks.beginner: Use this for timing changes that need twice the resolution of beat-based logic.
callbacks.example:
function onStepHit()
    if curStep == 64 then
        cameraShake('game', 0.02, 0.2)
    end
end
tips: Check curStep before applying one-time changes.

callbacks.name: onEvent
callbacks.description: Fired when an event is triggered.
callbacks.beginner: Use this to react to chart events. value1 and value2 contain the event's custom values.
tips: Compare eventName before using the values.

callbacks.name: goodNoteHit
callbacks.description: Fired when player hits a note.
callbacks.beginner: Use this to react to successful player notes or specific note types.
tips: noteData identifies the direction.
isSustainNote is true for held notes.

callbacks.name: opponentNoteHit
callbacks.description: Fired when opponent hits a note.
callbacks.beginner: Use this for effects triggered by opponent notes.
tips: This is separate from goodNoteHit.

functions.name: addLuaSprite
functions.description: Adds a Lua sprite to the scene.
functions.beginner: Displays a sprite created with makeLuaSprite.
tips: Use the same tag in both calls.
Set front to true to draw above characters.

functions.name: makeLuaSprite
functions.beginner: Creates a sprite object, but does not display it until you call addLuaSprite.
tips: The image is relative to the mod's images folder.
Tags are names you choose and reuse later.

functions.name: playAnim
functions.description: Plays an animation on an object.
functions.beginner: Changes an animated object's current animation.
tips: The animation name must exist in the object's atlas or character definition.
Optional arguments can usually be omitted.

functions.name: setProperty
functions.description: Sets a property on an object or playState variable.
functions.beginner: Changes a property such as alpha, x, y, angle, or visible.
tips: Use dot notation for nested properties.
Numbers and booleans should not be quoted.

functions.name: getProperty
functions.description: Gets a property value from an object.
functions.beginner: Reads a value so your script can make a decision or calculate a change.
tips: Store the returned value in a local variable when reusing it.

functions.name: runTimer
functions.beginner: Schedules a delayed action without blocking the game.
tips: Handle the tag in onTimerCompleted.
Time is measured in seconds.

functions.name: startTween
functions.beginner: Smoothly changes one or more properties over time.
tips: Use a unique tag for each tween.
Check the Psych Engine version for supported option fields.
